shrimps text index | photo index Phylum Arthropoda

Subphylum Crustacea > Class Malacostraca > Order Decapoda > Family Hippolytidae > prawns and shrimps Humpbacked shrimp
awaiting identification*
Family Hippolytidaeupdated Jan 2020

Where seen? This tiny green shrimp is sometimes seen on some of our shores near and on reefs, on seagrasses, coral rubble and soft corals.

Features: Less than 1cm long. Body thick with an obvious humped back. A broad long ‘nose’. It doesn’t have long pincers. Usually green.

Several different species of shrimps might have this appearance.
Sisters Island, Oct 11

Sisters Island, Jan 01

On a flowery soft coral. Cyrene Reef, Aug 10

*Species are difficult to positively identify without close examination.
On this website, they are grouped by external features for convenience of display.
